roles.name: Shared semantic flow and aggregate identity architecture
roles.lens: Survey SemanticResolver and TypedSemanticProvenance, with TypeChecker, TypedSemanticGraph, relevant types, and IR as read-only boundaries. Focus on aggregate identity/ownership, exact selector paths, tuple-root and sibling behavior, nullable narrowing/coalescing, reassignment, captures, and branch flow. Compare local map/set repairs, a shared immutable provenance algebra with transfer functions, and one bounded semantic abstract interpreter; identify the missing shared abstraction, soundness/precision trade-offs, migration seams, contract boundaries, and broad test/gate implications. Separate verified facts from inference and reserve implementation ownership for the resolver/provenance side, without editing or prescribing narrow fixes.

roles.name: Higher-order callable state and eager initialization analysis
roles.lens: Analyze InitializationAnalyzer and its typed-graph boundary, using Domain11SemanticTest and the specifications as evidence. Focus on higher-order parameter/result flow, callable values inside arrays/tuples/projections, identity-preserving calls, captured mutable cells, branch/coalesce joins, source-position-sensitive replacements, positional eager argument binding, recursion guards, legal function recursion, and conservative cross-module value cycles. Compare an independently gated 11B analysis with a shared bounded flow/effect interpreter, define inputs/outputs/invariants/source-of-truth ownership and validation gates, and map file-overlap risks so this domain does not concurrently edit resolver/provenance files. Distinguish true contract requirements, over-approximation, and phase-12 concerns; do not implement.

roles.name: Contextual typing, contract boundaries, and phase-11 recovery red team
roles.lens: Audit TypeChecker, TypedSemanticGraph, IrValidator, type-rule files, and Domain11SemanticTest against language-core.md and backend-runtime.md. Focus on then-only Unit conditionals, nested/block/composite nil inference, bare/non-nil #NIL rejection, forged graph types, contextual propagation, and the semantic-versus-IR publication boundary. Cross-check and red-team the proposed 11A provenance/flow, 11B callable/eager, and 11C contextual-nil gates by classifying tuple-root nested mutation, sibling-selector taint, branch joins, and eager-cycle conservatism as contract, over-strictness, or later-phase scope. Design the staged recovery protocol, counterexample/regression matrix, independent validation order, non-overlapping test/ownership boundaries, and decisions needing owner approval, while treating implementation files as evidence rather than assigning concurrent edits.
